title: 第1871章 星图第1870章 青云洞天
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
他们修为参差不齐，来自太虚仙域各个角落，但有一个共同点，都对六大势力僵化的格局感到失望，都愿意追随那个在炼丹仲裁上以一己之力让太乙洞天低头的人。江辰将这些散修按照各自擅长领域编成若干小队，有的专门负责情报分析，有的负责遗迹勘探，有的负责后勤保障。天剑峰的陆川、柳音和孟凡分别担任各小队的队长。归墟的规模虽远不能与六大势力相比，但麻雀虽小五脏俱全。
不灭之魂的变化比归墟的发展更让江辰欣慰。这只曾经在封印中沉睡了无数万年的星空巨兽，在太虚剑宗的生活中逐渐褪去了初醒时的茫然和孤僻。它开始主动与天剑峰的弟子们交流，最初只是在后山剑意石刻林附近独自徘徊，后来开始去演武场观看弟子们切磋剑法。地剑峰那位曾败在江辰剑下的首席陆剑离，某日在演武场上看到不灭之魂正蹲在角落里认真地观看弟子们的剑阵演练，手里还拿着一根不知从哪捡来的枯枝在地上画着螺旋秘文。陆剑离愣了片刻，然后走过去主动给它讲解万剑归宗剑阵的能量节点原理。不灭之魂听完后安静许久，用枯枝在地上画出了一个陆剑离从未想过的更高效的能量节点排列方式。
剑玄真人送给不灭之魂的礼物是在归墟成立后不久。老峰主将一柄以虚冥族手法打造的虚空长剑从不离身的木剑中取出，那柄剑的剑身由纯粹的虚空晶石淬炼而成，剑格处刻着与不灭之魂右掌上的暗银纹路完全一致的螺旋秘文。他告诉不灭之魂，这柄剑是用与它同源的虚空本源在剑庐后山的剑炉里花费了数日淬炼而成，不是武器，是纪念。纪念它来到太虚剑宗，也纪念那些早已消逝在虚空中的创造者。不灭之魂接过剑沉默了良久，然后用虚冥族最古老的礼节单膝跪地，双手捧着剑柄认认真真地行了一礼，声音低沉却格外郑重：“谢谢您。我从未被创造者之外的人赠予过东西。这柄剑，我会一直带着。”
噬天虫的第四次进化来得毫无征兆。
从云隐星地下神殿返回太虚剑宗后，两只噬天虫便一反常态地安静下来。它们不再像往常那样趴在江辰肩头发出细碎的嗡鸣，也不再主动飞出去寻觅废弃材料啃噬，而是双双蜷缩在他的修炼室角落里，背上的透明翅膀紧紧收拢，腹中的暗金纹路明灭不定，如同两盏在深夜中缓缓呼吸的孤灯。江辰检查过它们的状态，神魂纽带传来的反馈并无危险信号，只是它们体内积累的能量正在以一种他从未感知过的方式重新排列、重新编织。他想起在地下神殿祭坛核心处，这两只小家伙曾趁他破解玉简封印时，偷偷啃噬了祭坛核心处残留的虚冥族本源碎片。那碎片中蕴含的是虚冥族在创造五只星空巨兽时使用的原始虚空本源，与不灭之魂体内的本源同根同源，只是更加古老、更加纯粹。他将修炼室的防护阵法全部激活，吩咐陆川守在门外，任何人不许打扰。
进化持续了七日。第八日清晨，修炼室中忽然爆发出一道刺目的暗金光芒。那光芒穿透了防护阵法的层层屏障，将整座天剑峰后山都映照得如同白昼。剑玄真人正在剑庐中打坐，感应到这股气息后猛地睁开眼，身形一晃便出现在修炼室门外，沉声问守在门口的陆川发生了什么事。陆川也是一脸茫然，只说江师弟的虫宠在进化，已经持续了七日。剑玄真人盯着那扇被暗金光芒映照得几乎透明的石门看了片刻，缓缓说道：“不必担心。这股气息老夫曾在永暗星域的虚冥族遗迹中感受过，是虚冥族最本源的创造之力。你师弟的虫宠，怕是要脱胎换骨了。”
当暗金光芒缓缓收敛，修炼室的石门从内向外推开，江辰从室中走出。他的双肩上，两只噬天虫已然模样大变。它们不再只是米粒大小，而是能够自由控制体型，此刻正以手掌大小示人，琥珀色的身体完全透明，体内那条暗金纹路清晰可见，如同一幅被精心蚀刻在它们体内的微型虚空星图。背上的透明翅膀完全展开时，翅膀表面那一圈圈曾经的暗金纹路已扩展成了一片完整的法则纹路，每一次振动都会在周围虚空中激起一圈肉眼可见的空间涟漪。而当它们将体型膨胀到最大时，翼展可达数丈之巨，足以驮着一个人穿梭虚空。
更让江辰在意的是它们背上那幅暗金纹路。当噬天虫将体型膨胀到最大、翅膀完全展开时，翅膀表面那些曾经只是散乱分布的暗金纹路，此刻竟呈现出极其精密而有序的排列，那是一幅完整的虚冥族星图。每一道纹路的走向都对应着一条已知的虚空航线，每一个纹路节点都标注着一处曾经属于虚冥族的据点位置。这幅星图的规模远超他从暗渊据点和归墟遗物中搜集到的所有星图之和，它将虚冥族全盛时期的所有重要据点全部标注在内，从永暗星域到太虚仙域，从已被彻底摧毁的虚冥古墟到那些至今仍沉睡在某颗废弃星球地下深处的未知遗迹。
他让陆川取来太虚仙域最精密的拓印法器，将噬天虫背上那幅暗金星图小心翼翼地拓印下来。拓印过程极其耗时，星图的纹路太过繁复，每一道纹路都需要法器以最高精度逐寸扫描记录，整个拓印持续了数个时辰。拓印完成后，他将这幅星图与归墟留下的资料逐一对比核实，发现那些被归墟标注为“已确认”的暗渊据点只占星图中极小的一部分，而星图上至少还有十余个规模远超虚冥古墟的大型遗迹至今未被任何人发现。它们沉睡在太虚仙域各个偏远角落的地下深处，甚至有些就在六大势力眼皮底下，却因为虚冥族阵纹的天然屏蔽能力而从未被探测到。有了这幅星图，归墟组织便可以不再依赖于被动的情报搜集，而是主动出击，有计划地勘探和发掘那些尚未被任何人染指的虚冥族遗迹。

content_en:
Their cultivation levels are uneven and they come from all corners of the Taixu Immortal Realm, but they have one thing in common: they are all disappointed with the rigid structure of the six major forces, and they are all willing to follow the person who single-handedly made Taiyi Dongtian bow in the alchemy arbitration. Jiang Chen organized these casual cultivators into several teams according to their respective areas of expertise. Some were responsible for intelligence analysis, some were responsible for ruins exploration, and some were responsible for logistics support. Lu Chuan, Liu Yin and Meng Fan from Tianjian Peak serve as captains of each team respectively. Although the scale of Guixu is far from comparable to that of the six major forces, the sparrow is small but has all the internal organs.
The changes in the Immortal Soul made Jiang Chen more gratified than the development of Guixu. This giant starry beast that had been sleeping in a seal for countless thousands of years gradually lost the confusion and loneliness it felt when it first woke up in the life of the Taixu Sword Sect. It began to take the initiative to communicate with the disciples of Tianjian Peak. At first, it just wandered alone near the Sword Intention Stone Carving Forest in the back mountain. Later, it began to go to the martial arts field to watch the disciples compete in swordsmanship. Lu Jianli, the chief of Dijian Peak who had been defeated by Jiang Chen's sword, saw the Immortal Soul crouching in the corner at the martial arts field one day, carefully watching the disciples' sword formation drills. He was also holding a dead branch picked up from somewhere in his hand and drawing spiral secrets on the ground. Lu Jianli was stunned for a moment, then walked over and took the initiative to explain the energy node principle of the Ten Thousand Swords Guizong Sword Formation to it. The Immortal Soul was quiet for a long time after listening, and used dead branches to draw a more efficient arrangement of energy nodes on the ground that Lu Jianli had never thought of.
Master Jianxuan's gift to the Immortal Soul came shortly after Guixu was established. The old peak master took out a long void sword made with the technique of the Void Clan from the wooden sword that never left his body. The sword's blade was tempered from pure void crystals, and the sword grid was engraved with a spiral secret text that was exactly the same as the dark silver pattern on the right palm of the Immortal Soul. He told the Immortal Soul that this sword was made from the same source of void as it and spent several days tempering in the sword furnace on the mountain behind Jianlu. It was not a weapon, but a memorial. To commemorate its coming to Taixu Sword Sect, and also to commemorate those creators who have long since disappeared in the void. The Immortal Soul took the sword and was silent for a long time. Then he knelt down on one knee using the oldest etiquette of the Void Tribe. He held the hilt of the sword in both hands and saluted seriously. His voice was low but extremely solemn: "Thank you. I have never been given anything by anyone other than the creator. I will always carry this sword with me."
The fourth evolution of the Sky-eating Insect came without any warning.
After returning to the Taixu Sword Sect from the Yunyin Star Underground Temple, the two Sky-Eating Insects became uncharacteristically quiet. They no longer lay on Jiang Chen's shoulders and made a small buzz as usual, nor did they take the initiative to fly out to look for discarded materials to gnaw. Instead, they both huddled in the corner of his training room, with the transparent wings on their backs tightly folded, and the dark gold lines in their bellies flickering on and off, like two solitary lamps breathing slowly in the middle of the night. Jiang Chen checked their status, and there was no danger signal in the feedback from the soul bond. It was just that the energy accumulated in their bodies was being rearranged and rewoven in a way that he had never sensed before. He remembered that at the core of the altar in the underground temple, these two little guys had taken advantage of him to crack the seal of the jade slip and secretly gnawed at the remaining fragments of the Xuming clan's origin at the core of the altar. Contained in that fragment is the original void source used by the Void Clan when they created the five starry sky beasts. It has the same origin as the source in the Immortal Soul, but is older and purer. He activated all the protective formations in the training room and ordered Lu Chuan to guard outside the door and no one was allowed to disturb him.
The evolution lasted seven days. On the early morning of the eighth day, a dazzling dark golden light suddenly erupted in the training room. The light penetrated the layers of protective formations and illuminated the entire mountain behind Tianjian Peak like daylight. Master Jianxuan was meditating in the Jianhut. After sensing this breath, he suddenly opened his eyes and appeared outside the door of the training room. He asked Lu Chuan who was guarding the door in a deep voice what happened. Lu Chuan also looked confused, onlyIt was said that Junior Brother Jiang's insect pet was evolving and it had been going on for seven days. Master Jianxuan stared at the almost transparent stone door illuminated by the dark golden light for a moment, and said slowly: "Don't worry. I have experienced this breath in the ruins of the Vulture Clan in the Eternal Dark Star Territory. It is the most original creative force of the Vulture Clan. Your junior brother's insect pet may have to be reborn."
When the dark golden light slowly converged, the stone door of the training room was pushed open from the inside out, and Jiang Chen walked out of the room. On his shoulders, the two sky-devouring insects had completely changed their appearance. They are no longer just the size of rice grains, but can freely control their body shape. At this moment, they are the size of a palm. Their amber bodies are completely transparent, and the dark gold lines in their bodies are clearly visible, like a miniature void star map that has been carefully etched into their bodies. When the transparent wings on the back are fully unfolded, the circles of dark gold lines on the surface of the wings have expanded into a complete pattern of laws. Every vibration will stir up a circle of spatial ripples visible to the naked eye in the surrounding void. When they expand to their maximum size, their wingspan can reach several feet, enough to carry a person through the void.
What concerned Jiang Chen even more was the dark gold pattern on their backs. When the Sky-eating Insect expanded to its maximum size and its wings were fully unfolded, the dark gold lines that were once just scattered on the surface of the wings now showed an extremely precise and orderly arrangement. It was a complete star map of the Void Clan. The direction of each pattern corresponds to a known void route, and each pattern node marks the location of a stronghold that once belonged to the Void Clan. The scale of this star map far exceeds the sum of all the star maps he collected from Dark Abyss strongholds and Guixu relics. It marks all the important strongholds of the Void Clan in its heyday, from the Eternal Dark Star Territory to the Taixu Immortal Territory, from the completely destroyed Xuming Ancient Ruins to the unknown ruins that are still sleeping deep underground on an abandoned planet.
He asked Lu Chuan to get the most sophisticated rubbing instrument from the Taixu Immortal Realm and carefully rub the Dark Venus map on the back of the Sky-Eating Insect. The rubbing process was extremely time-consuming. The lines of the star map were too complicated. Each line required a magic weapon to be scanned and recorded inch by inch with the highest precision. The entire rubbing lasted for several hours. After the rubbings were completed, he compared and verified the star map one by one with the information left by Guixu, and found that the Dark Abyss strongholds marked as "confirmed" by Guixu were only a very small part of the star map, and there were at least a dozen large ruins on the star map that were far larger than the Xuming Ancient Ruins that had not yet been discovered by anyone. They sleep deep underground in remote corners of the Taixu Immortal Domain, and some are even right under the noses of the six major forces, but have never been detected due to the natural shielding ability of the Xuming Clan's formations. With this star map, the Guixu organization can no longer rely on passive intelligence collection, but can take the initiative and plan to explore and excavate the ruins of the Void Clan that have not been touched by anyone.
